note: Azerbaijan: an employer needs a work permit for every foreigner it employs, save the cases of the Migration Code's art. 64; its exemption for art workers holds only for those invited and registered with the relevant authority, a condition left out, so no days without the permit.

sources.title: The Migration Code of the Republic of Azerbaijan, English translation (State Committee for Family, Women and Children Affairs, 2018), arts. 63–64
sources.said: 63.2. Except for cases stipulated in the Article 64 of this Code, legal entities, physical persons engaging in entrepreneurship not establishing a legal entity and branch offices and representations of foreign legal entity shall get a working permit for every foreigner or stateless person they want to employ. ... 64.0.11. art workers, coaches and athletes invited to work in sport clubs and registered at relevant executive authority;
